question: Mu somo ly'Essomabiramu, omusomesa ateekawo ekigendererwa kino eri Ekibiina ekisooka: "Okunnyonnyola ekitera okubaawo ku miti gy'ebibala mu biseera by'omwaka eby'enjawulo." Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekisinga okuba ekituufu okukebera obumanyirivu bw'abayizi?
answer_a: Bawe akapapula omwereere muyizi era omugambe okuzimba omuti gw'ekibala ky'asinga okwagala mu biseera by'omwaka bibiri.
answer_b: Waawa abaana ebifaananyi eby’enjawulo ebiraga emiti egy’engeri ez’enjawulo, oluvannyuma obasabe okugigawula mu miti egibala ebibala n’egitaliimu bibala.
answer_c: Ggwe omuyizi, kuliko olupapula olulina ebifaananyi by'emiti gy'ebibala. Buli muti guliiko ekiseera kyagwo eky'omwaka ekyolekeddwa. Ggwe kolela buli muti langi eyo etuukana n'ekiseera kyagwo ekyolekeddwa.
answer_d: Bawe abaana kaadi eziriko ebifaananyi by'emiti egy'enjawulo n'endala eziriko ebibala, oluvannyuma obasabe okukwataganya omuti n'ekibala ekigugwanira.

question: Ekibiina ky'abaana abato balaba ng'oluggya lujjudde ebimuli by'engeri n'ebiragala eby'enjawulo. Omusomesa akozesa omukisa guno okubakubiriza okunoonyereza ku nsonga eno okuyita mu mitendera gino: 1. Bakuŋŋaanya ebikoola by'ebimuli eby'enjawulo ebigudde mu luggya. 2. Bageraageranya enkula n'ebiragala by'ebikoola bye bakuŋŋaanyizza. 3. Baddamu ekibuuzo ky'omusomesa: "Kiki ekinaabaawo singa tubiteeka mu mazzi?" 4. Bateeka ebikoola mu kintu omuli amazzi. Kintu ki omusomesa ky'akubiriza abaana okukozesa mu kibuuzo ky'ababuuzizza mu kiseera ky'omulimu guno?
answer_a: Okukebereza
answer_b: Okwekenneenya okukulemberwa
answer_c: Okuteebereza ebinaavaamu
answer_d: Okugeraageranya ku bubaka

question: Omusomesa annyonnyola abaana ku nkyukakyuka y'embeera amazzi ze gayitamu. Mu mbeera zino wammanga, y'eriwa eyinza okulagibwa ng'ekyokulabirako ky'ekifulukwa (condensation)?
answer_a: Okugwa kw'omuzira ku mazzi g'omugga
answer_b: Enkyukakyuka y'omuzira okufuuka omukka olw'amaanyi g'omusana
answer_c: Okuwoola kw'amazzi g'ennyanja n'okufuuka kwayo omuyembe.
answer_d: Okufukirira amayinja agalekebwa ku mukka oguva mu kasulo k’amazzi agabuguma

question: Omusomesa alaga abaana ekifaananyi ekiraga enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’ekintu okuva mu ngumu okudda mu ggaasi. Kyaki erinnya ly’enkyukakyuka y’embeera omusomesa gy’ayagala okukolako?
answer_a: Enfuufu
answer_b: Okufuuyuka
answer_c: Okutulukuka
answer_d: Okutabika

question: Lowooza ku mbeera eno: Omusomesa ali mu kusomesa ebikwata ku nnyanja mu kitundu ekikwata ku Biramu n’Obutonde Bwebyetoolodde. Ku lw’ekyo, alaga vidiyo eraga ennyanja ng’eri mu mpewo ezikunta. Omu ku baana ababuuza lwaki empewo zikunta. Ku bino ebiddako, kiki omusomesa ky’asaanidde okwogerako ng’ensonga enkulu evaako empewo okukunta?
answer_a: Omuyaga
answer_b: Amaanyi agasikira ebintu ku Mwezi
answer_c: Enjawulo mu bwoki bw’omu bbanga
answer_d: Enkyukakyuka mu bwoki bw'amazzi g'ennyanja

question: Soma embeera eno: Mu kibiina ky'abaana abato, Ignacio ayanjula ku ky'ekyennyanja ekya clownfish eraannyonnyola bagenzi be nti ekika kino kifuna obukuumi okuva ku ttooki y'ennyanja okulwanyisa abalya ebyennyanja ebirala, ate era n'ettooki y'ennyanja ekuumibwa kubanga ekyennyanja kigoba ebyennyanja ebirala ebigirya. Omusomesa ayingirawo okubannyonnyola erinnya ly'ekika ky'enkolagana y'ebiramu ekyogeddwaako omwana. Nkola ki ey'enkolagana y'ebiramu omusomesa gy'asaanidde okwogerako mu kunnyonnyola kwe?
answer_a: Obuwangwa obw’okubeera awamu nga ekimu ku biramu kiganyulwa ate ekirala tekirina kye kifuna wadde okufiirwa.
answer_b: Amensalism kitegeeza omukwano wakati w'ebiriwo ebimu gye kiremesa ekirala so nga kyo tekirina kye kifiirwa.
answer_c: Obutalina ludda lwe bayimiriddeko
answer_d: Omukwano ogw'obuyambi obwa buli omu

question: Omusomesa akoze emirimu gino wammanga ku kitundu eky’okuyiga ekikwata ku ndabika y’akaziba: 1. Abayizi basoma era neekebejja ebiwandiiko ebikwata ku ndabika y’akaziba ey’omulembe n’ebipimo byayo ebikulu. 2. Abayizi bakola ku bizibu ebikwata ku ndabika y’akaziba n’ebintu ebigirimu, n’enteekateeka y’amasannyalaze, n’ennamba za kwantaamu. 3. Abayizi bakubaganya ebirowoozo mu bibinja ku biwandiiko ebikwata ku nkyukakyuka mu ndabika y’akaziba n’ebipimo byayo ebikulu nga balina ebifaananyi ebigyoleka (Democritus, Dalton, Thomson, Rutherford, Bohr). 4. Abayizi bakola okugeraageranya ku ndabika z’akaziba ez’enjawulo nga booleka ebipimo byazo ebikulu. Mu nteekateeka zino wammanga, engeri ki esinga okukubiriza okuyiga okutondekawo okutegeera okw’amaanyi ku ndabika y’akaziba?

Mu kukebera okw’enkomerero, omusomesa w’ebiramu akwataganya ekibuuzo kino: ‘Nkyukakyuka ki mu mubiri omukazi ze yandibadde nazo singa aweereddwa eddagala eriziyiza omulimu gwa GnRH? Zinnyonnyole.’ Kintu ki ku biragiro by’okukebera ekolebwako n’ekibuuzo kino?
answer_a: Omulimu gw'obuwangwa oguleeta enkyukakyuka mu buvubuka.
answer_b: Nnyonnyola engeri omutwe gw’obwongo gye gufugaamu omusinde gw’eb激素 eziva mu kitundu kya hypothalamus ku musinde gw’ebisa eggi n’omubiri gw’ennyingo.
answer_c: Nnyonnyola omulandira gw’ebintu ebiddiring’ana mu mutendera gw’ekizadde ng’okozesa omutendera gw’obuwulukuto, okuva kw’eggimu, n’omutendera gwa luteal.
answer_d: Nnyonnyola omulandira gw’ebintu ebiddiring’ana mu mutendera gw’omubiri gw’ekyenda nga bikwatagana n’okukyenga omusaayi, ekiseera eky’okukula, n’ekiseera eky’okukola ebintu.

question: Mu kitundu "Amaanyi G'amasannyalaze n'Emigugu gy'amasannyalaze" mu kibiina ekya kkumi na bibiri, omusomesa ayagala abayizi be okusemberera okussaawo amateeka nga bayita mu kwetegereza omukwano wakati w'ebintu ebirambika. Mu mbeera y'etteeka lya Ohm, ku bikolwa bino wammanga kiki ekisaana okukozesebwa ku nsonga eno?
answer_a: Abayizi bakola eggulaafu eraga amaanyi g'amasannyalaze agavaamu (current intensity) okusinzira ku voltisi mu sikito entuufu, nga balowooza nti obuzibu (resistance) bwa nkalakkalira.
answer_b: Abayizi bakola ggulaafu okuva mu mmeeza erimu ebipimo by'amaanyi g'amasannyalaze agayita mu waya ku buli voltisi, oluvannyuma ne baginnyonnyola.
answer_c: Abayizi bakkaanya ku buzibu bw'ebintu ebikulembera amasannyalaze; buli omu aweebwa omuwendo gw'amasannyalaze n'amaanyi g'amasannyalaze nga bipimiddwa mu nkola.
answer_d: Abayizi baweebwa ebipimo by'amasannyalaze ebitali bifaanagana ne bakakasa, nga bayisaawo omugatte gw'amasannyalaze agasaliddwa ku buli kimu, oba ng'ekipimo ky'amasannyalaze ekyatuukirizibwa omukolezi kituufu.

question:
Kusooka, abayizi balina okuba nga bamanyi ebikwaata ku:
1. Empalirizo eziri mu atomu (atomic structure)
2. Enkyukakyuka z’enukiriya (nuclear reactions)
3. Okusattuluka kw’enukiriya (radioactive decay)
4. Ebika by’obusattuluzi (types of radiation) nga alufa, beta, ne gamma.
answer_a: Ensibika y'obusirikale bw'akaziba
answer_b: Ensibuko y'obutoffaali bw'ebintu
answer_c: Enkola y'obusengeke bw'amasannyalaze mu atomu
answer_d: Endabika y'ebipimo by'obuzito bw'akaziba k'ekintu

question: Kintu ki omuyizi ky’alina okuba ng’amanyi okusobola okukola ku musingi gwa VSEPR mu molekyu ez’enjawulo?
answer_a: Omugatte gw'akanyigirizi ka dipole oguvaamu molekyu ez'enjawulo
answer_b: Eteeka lya duet ne octet ku nkola y'obuziba.
answer_c: Okukiikirira empandiika z'ebisengeke bya kemiko ebiri mu molekyuulu
answer_d: Akakodyo ka valence shell electron pair repulsion (VSEPR) nga kakozesebwa ku molekyu ez'enjawulo.

question: Mu kiseera ky’eklassi ku nkola enkulu eza obutaffaali bw’amasannyalaze ag’ekkemiko mu makolero, pulofeesa ayogera ku butaffaali bw’amasannyalaze ag’ekkemiko obutundibwa obuyitibwa akataffaali ka Downs, akasobozesa okufuna sodiyamu ow’ekyuma nga tuyita mu kuyabuluza omunnyo gwa sodiyamu kkalolayidi (NaCl) oguyengeddwa. Ku bino ebikulu wammanga, kiki ekisobola okulabwa mu kiseera akataffaali ka Downs we kakolera?
answer_a: Sodiyamu ey’ekyuma eterekebwa ku anode olw’okukendeeza kwa ayoni za sodiyamu
answer_b: Ggaasi ya chlorine efulumizibwa ku cathode okuyita mu oxidation ya chloride ions.
answer_c: Ayoni za kkalolayidi zigenda ku anode okwoksidizibwa
answer_d: Obutaffaali bwa sodium butambula okudda ku cathode olw'enkendeeza yaabwo.

question: Omusomesa akola ku mutindo gw'ebintu by'omubumbire bw'ensi n'abayizi be ab'ekinaana era ayagala okukozesa ekintu ekya bulijjo okulaga ebika by'ensi. Mu bintu bino wammanga, kiki ekisobola okukozesebwa okwanjula omutwe guno obulungi?
answer_a: Egga enjigge enfumbe.
answer_b: Akawo ka Russia akateekateekaamu obukawo obulala
answer_c: Ebibala ebirimu ebitundu
answer_d: Akapiira ak'ebbombo

question: Omusomesa yateekawo ekibuuzo kino mu kigezo ky'ebikwata ku ntambula y'ebintu: “Omubiri gutambula okusinziira ku kibalangulo kino: x=25+40t−5t2 (nga t ali mu sikonda ate x ali mu mita). Omubiri gunaaba gutambudde mita mmeka nga wayiseewo 5 s ne 6 s?” Bw’amaze okukebera eby’okuddamu, omusomesa akiraba nti abayizi be tebakimanyi nti, okusinziira ku by’okuddamu byabwe, omubiri guba gutambudde obuwanvu butono mu kiseera kiwanvu, kubanga abasinga obungi baddamu nti omubiri gutambudde mita 100 mu sikonda 5 ate mita 85 mu sikonda 6. Ku ngeri eziri wammanga, engeri ki esinga okuba nga yaleetera abayizi abasinga obungi okuzibuwalirwa?
answer_a: Obuzibu obuli mu kusoma ebigambo ebikozesebwa mu bibuuzo bya kinemaatika
answer_b: Obutabaawo kwetendeka mu kumanya ebintu ebirambiddwa n'okukozesa ennyingo ezisaana.
answer_c: Okuteebereza okutali kukkufu ku nsonga ezitali nnamba eziva mu bibuuzo bya kinemattika.
answer_d: Obunafu mu kukulakulanya obukugu mu kubala okusobola okwaŋŋanga okugonjoola ebizibu bya kinemattika

question: Okukola ku kigendererwa ky'okuyiga ekigamba "Okulaga engeri enjawulo mu bwoki bw'ekintu gy'ekwatagana n'okuweereza amasoboza ag'ebbugumu wakati w'ebintu eby'enjawulo," omusomesa alina abayizi be okukola ebikolwa bino nga bakozesa ebintu bibiri. 1. Okubala ebbugumu eriyimbibwa ekintu. 2. Okupima n'okugeraageranya obwoki bw'ebintu ebyo ebibiri. 3. Okutegeera olukalo lw'ebbugumu we lutambulira wakati w'ebintu ebyo ebibiri. 4. Okubala obusobozi bw'ebintu okuyimiriza ebbugumu. Mu ngeri zino wammanga, lwaki olutalo olulaga omulandira ogutandikira ku birowoozo ebya bulijjo okudda ku birowoozo ebikalu ennyo?

Mu mutwe gw'ekitabo "Akaziba n'obusibe bwako," omusomesa ateesa omulimu ogugenderera abayizi be ab'omwaka ogw'okuna mu siniya: "Mukaanye ku makulu g'okuyiga obusibe bw'akaziba n'engeri tekinologiya gy'ayinza okubukozesaamu, nga mutunuulira nti, okuva ku ekyo ekigenda mu maaso mu busibe bw'akaziba obw'ebintu ebimu, kisoboka okufuna amasannyalaze n'okukulaakulanya tekinologiya aganyula abantu. Mu ngeri ey'enjawulo, mukubaganye ebirowoozo ku ngeri gye tuyinza okuzimbamu ebimera ebikozesa amaanyi ga nyukiriya mu ggwanga lyaffe okukola amasannyalaze." Mulimu ki omuyizi gw'ayinza okutuukako ng'akola omulimu oguteeseddwa?
answer_a: Nnyonnyola engeri atomu n’obusirikale bwamu gye bitegekeddwamu, ng’omanya enjawulo wakati w’ebintu eby’enjawulo n’ebipimo byabyo, wamu n’amaanyi ag’omusingi agalimu.
answer_b: Okukulaakulanya mu bayizi okutegeera obutonde bw’okumanya okwa ssaayansi okw’obusirikale bw’akaziba n’omulimu gw’abasaayansi b’obusirikale bw’akaziba
answer_c: Okubuguumiriza abayizi okwagala okukwataganya okusoma ku nnyukiriyaasi y'akaziba n'enkola za tekinologiya n'ebintu ebibaawo mu bulamu obwa bulijjo.
answer_d: Kulakulanya mu bayizi obusobozi okunyonyola engeri amaanyi gye gaggibwa mu nnyuklia y'akaziba n'engeri amaanyi gano gye gasobola okukyusibwamu okufuuka amasannyalaze.

question: Omusomesa ayagala okukebera obusobozi bw'abayizi be okutegeka ekibuuzo ky'okunoonyereza okwa ssaayansi okugenderera okumanya ebintu ebyeyambisibwa okuleetera ekintu okubuguma. Ku mirimu gino emikutudde, gumu ku gyo omusomesa gw'ayinza okukozesa okukebera obusobozi bw'omuyizi?
answer_a: Bakola okunoonyereza okuteekawo ebintu ebikozesebwa ebiyamba ekitu kibuukira ku mazzi, nga bateesa ebintu ebyetaagisa n'ebikozesebwa (ebikulukusi eby'enjawulo, ebintu eby'omutindo ogw'enjawulo, obuzito, n'enkula)
answer_b: Bakunganya ebipimo byebafunye okuva mukupima obukwafuwavu (densities) nokwetegereza engeri ebintu ebyenjawulo bwebiyimirira mumazzi ag'enjawulo, nga bakekkereza era nebamaliriza kubintu ebireetera ebintu okuyimirira mumazzi.
answer_c: Bakozesa obukakafu okuva mu kwetegereza engeri ebizimbulukuka bwe bibuutira mu bikulukusi eby’enjawulo n’okupima obukwafuwavu, nga bakozesa amagezi n’okuzimba ensonga ezinyweza okunnyonnyola kwabwe kwe basinziirako.
answer_d: Bakola ekirowoozo ekikeberebwa ekikwataganya okubuuka kw’ebintu ku nkyukakyuka ez’enjawulo, gamba ng’enkula, obukwafuwavu, n’obungi, nga bassaawo enkolagana entuufu wakati w’emiramu gy’ekisaayansi gino okuluŋŋamya enteekateeka yaabwe ey’okugezesa.

question: Mu birowoozo ebikyamu ebiri wammanga, kiki abayizi kye batera okuba nakyo ku bikolwa ebitakozesebwa maanyi mangi mu nkola ya sayansi w'amasoboza (thermodynamic processes)?
answer_a: Abayizi balowooza nti okweyongera mu bwetaavu (entropy) kiyamba mu kwetereera.
answer_b: Abayizi bagamba nti ebintu ebitayinza kulemesa nkola za butonde bisobola okuba nga byeyongera okwewooya.
answer_c: Abayizi balowooza nti ebintu ebigenda nga byokka na bwabyo bigenda mangu nnyo.
answer_d: Abayizi balowooza nti ebintu ebyetereera byesigama ku bwoki n’okusaasaanya amasoboza.

question:
Omusomesa ayagala ekibiina kye okumanya etteeka lya Hund erikwata ku bungi obusinga obuyinza okubaawo.
Kati ku mirimu gino wammanga, gumu ku gyo gwe gwandisinze okulaga obanga abayizi batuuse ku kiruubirirwa kino?
answer_a: Okuwandiika endagiriro z'obusannyalaza ez'ensi yonna ez'atomi ez'enjawulo nga ziri mu mbeera ey'ettaka.
answer_b: Okuwandiika empandiika enfunze eya elekitulooni ez’enjawulo mu atomu nga ziri mu mbeera ey’obutebenkevu.
answer_c: Okugeraageranya okusaasaanya kw'obusannyalaza mu dayagulaamu z'obusa okwetoloola akakungulu k'amasannyalaze agali ku ngulu mu atomu ez'enjawulo.
answer_d: Okukenenula endabika y’amasannyalaze ag’ebweru aga atomu ez’enjawulo nga ziri mu mbeera eya bulijjo n’eya kusisimuka.

question: Mu kibiina eky’omunaana, mu somo ly’ebizimbamubiri, omusomesa alimu okusomesa ku buzimbe bw’akaziba. Okukakasa oba abayizi bategeera enjawulo wakati w’omuwendo gw’akaziba n’omuwendo gw’obuzito, abasaba okulaga omuwendo gwa purotoni, elekitulooni, ne nnyutulooni mu aluminiyamu ataliimu kyagi, nga balowooza nti omuwendo gw’obuzito bwayo guli 27 n’omuwendo gw’akaziba guli 13. Abayizi bangi balaga bino wammanga: Aluminiyamu erina elekitulooni 27, purotoni 13, ne nnyutulooni 14. Buzibu ki abayizi bwe balaga mu nkola yaabwe ey’okuyiga ku bikwata ku ebyo ebiri mu somo?
answer_a: Okukkiriza nti omuwendo gw’obusannyalaza bugendana n’omugatte gwa puletoni ne nnyutroni
answer_b: Nga tebategedde nti namba y'akaziba etambulira wamu n'omuwendo gw'amasannyalaze ag'ekika kya pozitiivu
answer_c: Okukkiriza nti namba y'obuzito etegereza omuwendo gwa chaji ennungi n'embi
answer_d: Nga tetumanyi nti namba y'obuzito etambulira wamu n'omugatte gw'obuntu obuli mu busibe

question: Omusomesa ategekera ekibiina ky'abayizi abali mu mwaka ogwokusatu mu siniya, ng'ekigendererwa kyabwe kiri "Okutegeera empewozeso eya sentripeta n'amaanyi ga sentripeta ng'ebireetera ekintu okutambula mu ngeri ey'omuzingo ogwa kyenkanyi". Mu kumanya okukulembedde kuno okukwata ku vekita kuki abayizi kwe bateekwa okuba nga bamanyi okusobola okutegeera amaanyi ga sentripeta bwe gakola ku ntambula y'omubiri mu ntambula ey'omuzingo ogwa kyenkanyi?
answer_a: Okuggyako vekita
answer_b: Omugatte gwa vekita ezigayamu
answer_c: Omugatte gwa 'dot' wakati wa vekita
answer_d: Okutondeesa vekita nga tukozesa ebipimo bya Katisiyaani

question: Mu ndowooza zino ez'abayizi, eruwa ekoma ku kuyiga omusingi gwa Archimedes?
answer_a: Okulowooza nti puleesa y’omu bbanga terina nnyinirizo ku puleesa ya haidirositatiika eweebwa ekikulukusi
answer_b: Okulowooza nti obuziba ekintu kye kiyimiriddemu mu mazzi kye kireetera amaanyi agakirwanyisa okuba amangi oba amatono.
answer_c: Okulowooza nti akanyigirizi akakolebwa ku kintu ekiri mu mazzi kisinziira ku buziiba we kali
answer_d: Okulowooza nti akanyigirizi ka haidirositetiiki akateekebwa ekikulukusi ku ntobo y'ekintu ekirikulukusirwamu kisinziira ku ndabika y'ekintu ekyo.

question:
Omusomesa omukulu mu ssomero lya siniya ayagala abayizi be okutegeera ebintu ebikozesebwa okumanya obunene bw’ekitundu ky’obulamu bw’akaziba ka leediyoakitiivu.
Kiki ekiyinza okukolebwa okuyamba abayizi okutuuka ku kiruubirirwa ekyo?
answer_a: Laga omuwendo ogugenda gukendeera ogw'ekintu ekiralaadiyo nga gweyoleka mu ngeri y'omugereeso.
answer_b: Teebereza ku nkola y'obuwakiso bw'obusirikale bw'ekintu ekirungo ekya leediyo.
answer_c: Gattako amawulire okuva mu mmeeza y'ebipimo by'obuzito okukontana n'ebiseera ku nkyukakyuka y'ebintu eby'obusiraamu.
answer_d: Gegeenya okubulukuka kw'akaziba ka leediyoaktifu era okutegeera omuwendo gw'obusirikale obubulukuse.

question:
Omusomesa w’essomero lya siniya ey’omwaka ogusooka, mu somo ly’Ekigeranyo ky’Obuzito bw’Ebintu Ebikola Ekintu, yeetaaga okukebera okutegeera kw’abayizi ku bukulu bw’ebigeranyo by’obuzito bw’ebintu ebikola ekintu mu kikontaananyo ky’ekemyo ekikwatagana.

Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki omusomesa ky’ayinza okuteesa okukakasa okuyiga okwatuukiddwaako?
answer_a: Balaza omuwendo gw'ekigeranyo ky'akazimbulukusa wakati w'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebivaamu mu kikolwa.
answer_b: Balanguula obuzito bw'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebivaamu era okakase omukwano oguli wakati waabyo mu kubala.
answer_c: Zimba akabalansira akalaga obwenkanankana wakati w'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebivaamu, n'omuwendo gwabyo mu buli kikumi.
answer_d: Zimba akatebe akalaga omuganda oguli wakati wa mole, molekyu ne atomu, nga kisinziira ku bintu ebiri mu kikolwa ekyo.

question: Okukyuka kw’embeera y’ebintu kuki abaana abato ab’emyaka egyo gye basobola okulaba nga bakozesa omuko gw’ekyuma ekimulukuta?
answer_a: Okutabika
answer_c: Okukwata
answer_d: Enfuufu

question: Mu kibiina kya munaana, oluvannyuma lw’okumaliriza okunnyonnyola omulimu gw’ebitundu by’obutoffaali mu butoffaali bwa kika kya eukaryotic, omusomesa agenda kwongera okunnyonnyola omulimu gwabyo ng’akozesa olugero olufaananya ebyuma n’ebitundu by’ekkolero ku butoffaali. Mu ngero zino omusomesa z’agenda okwogerako, eruwa ku zino ekwatagana ne cytoskeleton?
answer_a: Ekyuma ekikyusa ebintu ebiramu okubifuula amaanyi
answer_b: Enkola etegeka ebintu mu ngeri esobozesa ebintu okutereera mu kkolero
answer_c: Ekifo ekikulu ekikulukusa amawulire agakwata ku kikolero era ne kiragira ebikolebwa mu kyo
answer_d: Ekyuma ekissa akabonero ku bintu ebiggyibwa mu ফ্যাক্টরি

question: Mu kukebera okw’akamalirizo, omusomesa ow’ekibiina eky’omunaana ategese ekigendererwa kino: “Okunnyonnyola emisingi gy’ennyingo ya Dalton ku atomu.” Ku biragiro bino wammanga, kiki ekiraga nti abayizi batuuse ku kigendererwa kino?
answer_a: Bikola ebintu eby'ekimiyiki eby'enjawulo okusinziira ku kulonda eby'obuziba bibiri oba okusingawo.
answer_b: Zimuteekawo omuwendo gw’obungi bw’obuziba obwetabye mu kikolwa eky’ekemiko.
answer_c: Zigikwataganya obuzito bw'ebintu ebiri mu kintu ekigatte n'obuzito bw'ekintu ekigatte kyonna.
answer_d: Bakakasa obuzito bw'ekintu ekiri mu bizimbamubiri bisatu eby'enkalubo y'emu.

question: Omusomesa ow’omwaka ogw’okuna mu siniya ateekateeka essomo erigendereddwa okuyamba abayizi okutegeera omugaso gw’okugemesa okw’ekikolimo mu by’obulamu bw’abantu bonna. Ku bikolwa bino wammanga ekiyinza okusobozesa omusomesa okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kino okutambulira wamu n’endagaano y’ebiri mu syllabus ekwata ku kumanya okw’ekisaayansi?
answer_a: Ban ব্যাখ্যা করে Edward Jenner এর মত ক্লাসিক পরীক্ষার ফলাফলের উপর ভিত্তি করে টিকাকরণের প্রভাব।
answer_b: Banoonyereza, nga basinziira ku chati, obungi bw’endwadde ezimu ezisiigala era ne bateebereza ebireeta obungi obwo.
answer_c: Bageraageranya, nga basinziira ku chati, omuwendo gw'abantu abaagemeebwa ne bagukwataganya n'okusaanyizibwawo n'okuddamu okubalukawo kw'endwadde ezimu.
answer_d: Bazimba olukalala lw'ebikulu ebyatuukiddwaako mu nkola y'okugema, nga balaga omukono gw'abasaayansi abaatandikawo omulimu guno.

question: Mu kibiina ky’omwaka ogusooka mu siniya, abayizi beenyigira mu bikolwa ebikwaata ku ngeri ebifaananyi gye bikolebwamu mu ndabirwamu empanvu ne mu ndabirwamu enkovu. Mu kiseera ky’ekikolwa, omuyizi agolola omukono gwe waggulu n’agamba: "Mwalimu, sikyategeera njawulo eri wakati w’ebifaananyi ebituufu n’ebifaananyi ebyekiise, wadde lwaki biyitibwa bitya." Kulaga ki omusomesa kw’anaakozesa okutangaaza okutabuka kw’omuyizi, ng’addamu mu ngeri etegeerekeka era n’obwegendereza obukulu ku kibuzo kye?
answer_a: Laba ku ludda olumu n'olulala olw'ekijiiko. Ekifaananyi ky'olaba nga bw'oli ddala kiba kya bweru ate ekifaananyi ky'olaba nga kikyuse kiba kya nnamaddala.
answer_b: Olukijjukira nti ebifaananyi ebituufu bulijjo biba bikkiddwa waggulu okudda wansi, ate ng’ebifaananyi eby’obulimba bulijjo biba bitereevu.
answer_c: Ebifaananyi eby'obulimba birabika ng'ibikolebwa emabega w'endabirwamu, ate nga ebifaananyi ebya ddala bikolebwa mu maaso gaayo era bisobola okukubibwa ku lutimbe.
answer_d: Ebifaananyi eby’obulimba bikolebwa mu kifo eky’obulimba ekireetera emiryango gy’omusana okugaziwa, ate ebifaananyi ebya ddala bikolebwa okuyita mu kulagula emiryango gy’omusana egidda waggulu.

question: Omusomesa w’eky’omubiri ow’omwaka ogw’okubiri mu siniya, mu mutwe gw’eky’ensengeka y’ebintu ebiri mu mugendo, agenda kukola okukebera okuzuula okumanya abayizi kwe balina ku ntambula y’ebintu ebigwa nga tebikoleddwako maanyi gonna. Okusinziira ku nsonga eyo, kwe kukola ki okukebera okunaasobozesa omusomesa okufuna obukakafu obusinga obulungi ku kumanya abayizi kwe balina edda ku mutwe ogwo?
answer_a: Mu kifo ky'ebweru, basuula ebintu eby'enjawulo waggulu era ne bageraageranya ebipimo bya buli kusula.
answer_b: Baddamu ebibuuzo ebigendereddwa okugeraageranya n'okusuubira obungi bw'ebiseera ebyetaagisa ebintu eby'enjawulo okugwa okuva waggulu obuwunzifu.
answer_c: Balaga mu kiifananyi obwolekera bw’amasoboza agaleetawo emisinde gy’akapiira k’omupiira ogw’ettaniisi nga kali mu bbanga okuva eri omuzannyi omu okudda eri omulala.
answer_d: Bakola maapu y'endowooza erimu ensonga z'ekibalangulo ezikwata ku ntambula y'ebintu ebigwa nga tebiriiko kiguzza.

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’okubiri mu siniya, mu mutwe gw’ekyegayiriro ky’ebintu (Stereochemistry) n’engeri ebintu bwe bifaanana (Isomerism), ateekateeka essomo eririna ekigendererwa kino: “Okutegeera obukulu bw’endaga ya R oba S mu bintu ebikozesebwa mu bulamu obwa bulijjo”. Ku mirimu gino wammanga, gwe gufaanagana n’okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekyo eri abayizi?
answer_a: Buuza abayizi okufumiitiriza ku makulu g'ebyenfuna agali mu kukola eddagala eririna ebika bya R ne S.
answer_b: Buuza abayizi okunoonyereza ku bintu ebibaawo ku bulamu bw’omuntu ng’akozesa eddagala ebbiri eriri mu ngeri ya enantiomers.
answer_c: Buuza abayizi okugeraageranya obuwangwa bw’ebintu ebirungo obwa R ne S stereoisomer obw’ebintu ebikozesebwa ennyo 5, gamba nga, ibuprofen
answer_d: Baagalire abayizi okukozesa amateeka ga Cahn-Ingold-Prelog okusalawo endagakubbo ya R ne S eya kampawundi 5 ezikozesebwa ennyo, ng'ekyokulabirako, frukitoosi.

question: Mu kibiina kya P8, omusomesa akoze ekigezo ku atomu n’engeri ayoni gye zikolebwamu. Ebivaamu biraga nti omuwendo munene ogw’abayizi balowooza nti okukolebwa kwa keyoni (cations) kuleetebwawo atomu okwongerako oba “okufuna” polotooni (protons). Mulimu ki omusomesa gw’ayinza okuteesa eri abayizi be okubayamba okutegeera obulungi engeri keyoni gye zikolebwamu?
answer_a: Buuza abayizi okutegeera omuwendo gwa puletoni, erikitulooni, ne nyutulooni eziri mu ayoni ez’enjawulo nga basinziira ku namba y’akaziba (Z) n’ennamba y’obuzito (A).
answer_b: Basabye abayizi okukola, awamu n'omusomesa, akatebe akalaga omuwendo gwa puletoni, eretulooni, ne nnyutulooni mu katayoni ne anayoni ez'enjawulo.
answer_c: Saba abayizi okukola ekibalanguwa ekiraga engeri emiramwa gino gye gikwatagana: akaziba, olububi, obusannyalaza, obukontanyo,obutaffaali, ayoni, kayoni, n’ayoni enkyamu
answer_d: Bayizi balambike okugeraageranya engeri atomu ya sodium entaanu gy'efaanana n'engeri sodium bw'efaanana ng'ekyebulukusi, nga balowooza ku muwendo gwa purotoni, elekitulooni, ne nyutulooni eza buli emu.

question: Omusomesa, mu mwaka ogusooka ogw'essomero eya Secondary, mu mutwe gw'eky'obulamu ogw'Enkyukakyuka n'Obungi bw'ebiramu, akola omulimu n'abayizi be mwe balina okugeraageranya amino asidi ez'enjawulo eza puloteni C okuva mu nsolo ez'enjawulo n'okuteebereza enkolagana y'eby'obusika wakati waazo. Mu kiseera ky'okukola omulimu guno, omuyizi abuuza: “Bwe kiba nti ekisukkulumya ebiramu kwe kuba n'amawulire mu DNA yaabyo, mugaso ki ogw'okugeraageranya ennyiriri za amino asidi eza puloteni?”. Nga tutunuulidde omutendera gw'omuyizi, mu nnyonnyola zino omusomesa gy'awa, eyiwa ku kibuzo ky'omuyizi?
answer_a: Ekizimbamubiri kye kimu kisobola okweyoleka mu biramu by’ebika eby’enjawulo. Amawulire agazimba ekizimbamubiri ago galondoolwa mu busirikale bw’obutonde (genes). N’olwekyo, okuyita mu kumanya enjawulo wakati w’obusirikale bw’obutonde obukola ekizimbamubiri n’olukalala lw’ebitundu by’ekizimbamubiri (amino acid sequences), enkolagana z’emyaka gy’obulamu wakati w’ebika bisobola okuteeberezebwa.
answer_b: Puloteni zikolebwa mu nnamba ennungi ey'obucaafu bw'amino acidi ekkodeddwa mu DNA. Bwe wabaawo enkyukakyuka mu kino, kyakukyusa endagiriro y'obucaafu bw'amino acidi obwa puloteni eyo. N'olwekyo, nga tutunuulidde omuwendo gw'obucaafu bw'amino acidi obwenjawulo obwa puloteni y'emu, omuntu ayinza okumanya engeri ebika eby'enjawulo gye bikwatagana mu nkulaakulana.
answer_c: Puloteni zikolebwa okuva mu kunnyonnyolwa kw’obubaka bwa RNA, obuva mu kuwandiika kwa jjiini. Puloteni eno esobola okulagibwa nga waliwo enkyukakyuka mu nkola y’obusirikale bw’amino asidi. N’olwekyo, nga tukozesa okunoonyereza ku nkola zino, enkolagana z’endabika y’ebiramu ez’enjawulo zisobola okuteekebwawo.
answer_d: Enkola y’obusirikale bw’ekikulukuto kya amino mu poloteyini esalibwawo enkola y’obubonero bwa codons obuba ku bubaka bwa RNA obukolebwa. Okuva buli codon lulinga enkola y’obusirikale busatu obwa nucleotides, bwe kikyusibwa, poloteyini erina enkola y’obusirikale bw’ekikulukuto kya amino eyawukana ku ya poloteyini eyasooka eyinza okufunika. N’olwekyo, okumanya omuwendo gw’ebikulukuto bya amino eby’enjawulo wakati w’ebika bibiri, omuntu ayinza okumanya nga bwe bikwatagana mu nkulaakulana.

question: Omusomesa omukulu mu S.2, mu kiseera ky’essomo ku DNA n’okukubisaamu obutaffaali, ategeka omulimu gw’okukolera ku kiruubirirwa kino: “Okutegeera engeri ebizimba bya kansa gye bikolebwa”. Bintu ki abayizi bye balina okuba nga bamaze okubimanya okusobola okukola ku kiruubirirwa kino?
answer_a: Ebiseera by'omutendera gw'obulamu bw'akataffaali
answer_b: Obukulu bw'ekigabanyo ky'obutaffaali ekya mitosis
answer_c: Ebifo omukutu gwe kikula ky'obutaffaali mwe guyita
answer_d: Ebika by'enkyukakyuka mu DNA ne mu chromosome

question: Omusomesa omutendeke ateekateeka essomo ly'ekibiina eky'okubiri ng'agenda kulambulula ekigendererwa kino: "Okukozesa etteeka ly'obungi bw'amaanyi obutakyuka mu nkola enzigale". Ku mirimu gino wammanga, gumu ku guleka abayizi okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekyo?
answer_a: Bawa ebyokulabirako by’obutomere obulaga nti obungi bw’amasoboza busigala nga bwe bwali.
answer_b: Bapima obuzito bw'emmotoka n'embiro emmotoka ze zaabadde nazo nga tezinnatomeragana n'embiro ze ziba nazo nga zimaze okutomeragana ku ttuleeki etalina bukakafu bwonna.
answer_c: Bano balaga omukwano wakati w'amaanyi agakozeseddwa, obudde bwe gamazeeko, n'empalirizo omubiri gwe gufuna mu layini emu.
answer_d: Balindiriza ekinavaamu okugong'ana wakati w'ebibiina by'ebiziyiza bibiri ebifanana nga biserebuka awatali kukwatagana.

question: Omusomesa omubisi omwaka ogusooka mu Ssekendulewa ateekateeka essomo n’ekigendererwa kino: “Okukozesa omutindo gw’amayengo okunnyonnyola nti ekitangaala kyeyoleka era ne kimenyeka bwe kikuba ekifo ekyawula ebintu bibiri.” Ng’enkola y’okuyigiriza okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kino, omusomesa asalawo okukozesa ebikozesebwa eby’okusomesa ebyanguya okutegeera ebyo ebiri mu somo. Kiki ku bikozesebwa eby’okusomesa wammanga ekikwatagana n’ekigendererwa ky’omusomesa kino?
answer_a: Ekitundu ky’ekitabo ky’essomero ekinnyonnyola enjawulo wakati w’endowooza y’obuntu n’ey’amayengo ku musana, n’obubaka buli emu bwe yawa ku misinde gy’omusana mu kubulukuka.
answer_b: Okutengejja okw’ekikompyuta okulaga mu bujjuvu engeri ebyoya by’omusaayi gw’amazzi gye bikosebwa olw’okukyusa n’okumenyeka kw’ekitangaala nga kikuba ekifo wakati w’ebintu bibiri
answer_c: Okulaga mu kibiina omutangaavu gwa leza nga gukuba amazzi agali mu akuliyamu, we kiyinza okulabirwa nti ekitundu ku mutangaavu guddamu waggulu ate ekitundu ekirala ne kimenyeka ku mpalazo engeri engeri.
answer_d: Omulimu ogukolebwa ku kompyuta ogusobozesa omuyizi okulaba nga omutangaavu bwe gutumizibwa ku kintu ekigabanya ebintu bibiri eby’enjawulo, ekitundu kimu kiguddamu ate ekitundu ekirala ne kiyitamu nga buli kimu kirina engeli yakyo.

question: Omulimu gw'abayizi abali mu mwaka ogw'okubiri gwe gumu ku mirimu gyebakolako kwe "Kutegeka n'okunnyonnyola ebikwaata ku physicochemical properties z'ebintu ebirina obutonde bw'obutonde." Ku mirimu gino wammanga, gwe guleka omuntu okukebereza ekigendererwa ekyo waggulu?
answer_a: Bawe abayizi data ku tempulikya ebyokulukusi bya haidrokaboni ez’obuwanvu bw’enziring’anya obw’enjawulo era obasabe okukekkereza oba ziri mu mbeera ya kalimagezi, amazzi oba ggaasi ku tempulikya y’omu kisenge.
answer_b: Baliriza abayizi okunoonyereza ku bubonero bw’okubulukuka kw’ebinywamaji bya kaboni eby’obuwanvu obwenjawulo, babitegeke mu mmeeza, era balambulule oba biri mu mbeera ya kikalu, kikulukusi, oba ggaasi ku tempulikya eya bulijjo.
answer_c: Weebale abayizi data ku tempulikya ebyokirokaboni ze zibulira ku buwanvu bw'enziringanya ez'enjawulo ezitegekeddwa mu tebuleni era obasabe okunnyonnyola empisa okusinziira ku mikwanaganyo egireeteddwa molekyuulu.
answer_d: Weebale abayizi data ku tempulikya ebyokola bwa haidrokaboni ez’obuwanvu bw’enziring’anya obw’enjawulo, ze balina okutegeka mu tebuleni okusinziira ku muwendo gwa kaboni mu nziring’anya oluvannyuma bannyonnyole engeri eno gy’ekolamu okusinziira ku bunene bw’enkolagana molekyu ze ziraga.
